item.title: Why The Bali 5.4 Should be Your Next Charter
item.description: The Bali 5.4 brings together space, comfort, and performance all in an impeccably designed 54-foot catamaran perfect for charter vacations. This yacht was built with a focus on open bright living spaces, comfortable accommodations, and plentiful outdoor spaces. With room for up to 12 in its six-cabin configuration, the Bali 5.4 is perfect for social sailing. Dream Yacht guests have the option to enjoy this yacht through a cabin cruise or when the yacht has availability outside of cabin charters, book it as a crewed yacht charter for an exclusive experience with family and friends. A Layout Designed for Living The center of the Bali 5.4’s design was built around bringing people together while still allowing space to spread out. Fluid flowing spaces from bow to stern creates seamless connection between the outdoor living areas, saloon, and aft cockpit. One of the most distinctive and innovative features of this yacht is the large pivoting rear door. It excellently connects the salon with the aft cockpit creating one extended living area and allowing for a larger conversation space. Another unique feature is the sliding windows that allow for more airflow and light giving an open air feel throughout. Forward of the saloon a door provides easy access to the foredeck. Here cushioned seats stretch out into the sun allowing guests to relax and enjoy the views while underway. While the aft cockpit provides a perfect gathering space for lunch or dinner at anchor with comfortable seating. The davits and swim ladder on the stern provide an easy access to the water for swimming. Then above there is a flybridge with a large U shaped seating area perfect for sipping a morning coffee with the sunrise or sundowners after a rewarding day of cruising. Forward of the seating area find the sunbathing pads where guests can lounge while taking in the breathtaking scenery of one of Dream Yacht’s incredible destinations. This Bali 5.4 provides so many areas where connection to the natural world and each other become possible. Find peace and shared experiences through innovation and exploration aboard this yacht. Take the Tour Comfortable Accommodations Below Deck The Bali 5.4 continues to deliver through its focus on comfort as we move below deck. Each cabin is equipped with queen sized beds, a private bathroom with a shower, and adequate storage space. Natural light and airflow are still features even down in the cabins; some cabins even have direct access to the deck. For large groups this layout is meant to give everyone their own private space at night, while relishing the communal spaces during the day. Guests get the feeling of home and settling in through these comfortable areas instead of the fleeting feeling of a hotel room. Why Charter the Bali 5.4 Space for Everyone – Roughly 130 square meters of living space allows for plenty of room to dine, relax, and enjoy cruising without feeling crowded. Indoor/Outdoor Living – The yacht’s flow from bow to stern and one of a kind opening door from the saloon to the aft cabin makes it easy to roam between the interior and exterior living spaces. Enjoy the breeze blowing through the yacht which creates a light airy open feel that connects you to the natural beauty of the surrounding world. Relaxation Area Options – There is no shortage of lounging areas onboard from the flybridge to the foredeck choose your ideal spot to enjoy the sail from. Now Newly Available for Private Crewed Charters When a Bali 5.4 is not being used on a cabin charter it will be available for a private crewed charter experience with a captain and hostess. This means families or groups of friends can experience the entire yacht privately, with a professional crew taking care of the sailing, itinerary, food, and day to day operation. Allowing guests to concentrate on relaxation and taking in the scenery from any of the comfortable lounging areas. item.title: What’s a Cabin Cruise? Everything You Need to Know Before Booking
item.description: Imagine waking up to the sound of water gently lapping against the hull, stepping outside, and diving straight into a clear, turquoise ocean. For a long time, enjoying a holiday like this meant you either needed a lifetime of sailing experience or the budget to rent a whole private vessel with a captain. Now, travelers can book a cabin cruise and experience the magic of a sailing vacation to an exotic destination for the price of a single hotel room. Even better, sailing experience is not required. You simply book your cabin, step aboard, and leave the work to the crew on board the yacht. Before you pack your bags and head for the marina, here is everything you need to know about this effortless way to explore the world. What Is a Cabin Cruise? A cabin cruise, also called a by-the-cabin sailing charter , is a style of travel where you rent a private stateroom or cabin on a yacht. The rest of the vessel is shared with a small group of like-minded travelers, so you have opportunities to socialize in between exploring islands and relaxing in your room. Every cabin charter trip features a carefully planned route, shared communal spaces, delicious meals, and a professional crew to run the ship. It’s an easy way to dip your toes into the yachting lifestyle. What Is a Cabin Charter Like? The entire travel process is designed to be stress-free from the moment you book your cabin cruise vacation to the day you head home. Choosing Your Destination and Dates Your journey begins by selecting where you want to sail and picking the dates that fit your schedule. These trips follow set itineraries, which you can view ahead of time. This way, you can see which ports you’ll visit and plan ahead of time. Arrival and Boarding When you arrive at the marina base, the crew will welcome you aboard and show you to your private stateroom. After a quick safety briefing and an introduction to the yacht, the captain casts off the lines and sets sail. Your Cruise Each day follows a relaxing rhythm of sailing, swimming, exploring hidden coves, and enjoying fresh meals on deck. While the captain handles the sailing, you share the spacious decks with your fellow passengers. Do You Need Sailing Experience? With this type of sailing vacation, no experience is required. You do not need to know how to tie a single knot, read a navigation chart, or handle a steering wheel. The price of your cabin includes the services of the captain and crew. They take care of navigation, weather tracking, anchoring, and all daily shipboard operations. The only thing you need to do the entire week is relax and have fun. What’s Included in a Cabin Yacht Charter? Inclusions vary based on the package you choose and the company you book with. Premium options, such as Dream Yacht ’s cabin cruises, typically include: A private, comfortable double cabin with its own bathroom Access to all shared yacht spaces, like the forward trampolines, salon, and sun decks The full services of a professional captain and cook Onboard water toys, which may include things like snorkeling gear, paddleboards, and kayaks Before booking, be sure to check the trip details to confirm inclusions and what you might need to cover during your cruise. Food, Beverages, and Culinary Options Many packages offer a half-board plan, which includes select meals such as breakfast and lunch. With half-board options, you may dine ashore at ports where you drop anchor. Other packages feature a full-board plan, which means breakfast, lunch, and dinner are included. Optional Excursions and Extras Depending on where you are sailing, you might have the option to add on excursions like guided island hikes and historical tours. It is always a good idea to check your specific package details before booking, so you know exactly what is covered and what extras you might want to explore. item.title: BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience: Best Yacht Charter Options for Beginners
item.description: Picture waking up to the sound of waves against the hull of a catamaran anchored in a secluded cove in the British Virgin Islands (BVI). Walk on deck and soak up the sunshine and the spectacular views this area is famous for. It’s the perfect holiday, and the best part is that no sailing experience is needed. With Dream Yacht Worldwide , you can enjoy a BVI yacht vacation without having to know a jib from a mainsail. We make sailing accessible to all, with three options especially suited for beginners: Easy Crew, Skippered, and Cabin Cruises. Can You Go on a BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience? Many people assume that exploring the ocean requires a formal captain’s license or a deep understanding of marine navigation. While renting a boat entirely on your own, known as a bareboat charter , requires sailing experience, there are plenty of ways to enjoy the sea without any technical knowledge. With a crewed BVI sailing vacation , you don’t need to stress about managing a vessel. Our team oversees managing the necessary tasks, such as tracking the weather, anchoring in a busy bay, or interpreting complex nautical terms. You’ll have experienced staff managing onboard systems for you while you enjoy the experience. Our modern catamarans are also stable boats, which means a very low risk of motion sickness and a comfortable stay for those new to life on the water. Best BVI Charter Options If You Don’t Know How to Sail Every traveler has a different preference when it comes to privacy, budget, and daily schedules. Dream Yacht Worldwide provides three distinct entry points designed to match your personal style. Best For Privacy Level Meals Budget Skippered Charter Families and friend groups High (Full private yacht) Cook your own meals or dine ashore Mid to High Easy Crewed Charter Milestone trips and relaxation seekers High (Full private yacht) Half or full board cooked by a host Premium Cabin Cruise Couples, solo travelers, and budget travelers Private cabin, shared deck Set meal plan included in the price Affordable BVI Skippered Yacht Charters: Ultimate Freedom and Privacy A skippered charter means you rent an entire yacht for your group and hire a professional captain to sail it. You have total control over your daily schedule, allowing you to choose exactly when to sail and which bays to visit. The captain handles all the physical labor, anchoring, and navigation, while you and your guests enjoy the exclusive use of the boat. A BVI catamaran charter with skipper is ideal for families who want to cook their own meals or try local beachside restaurants every night. BVI Crewed Yacht Charters: The Effortless Private Getaway If you want the ultimate luxury of a private boat combined with the service of an all-inclusive resort, consider an Easy Crewed charter . Along with a professional captain, you get a dedicated onboard host/cook to manage the galley and handle tasks like grocery shopping (provisioning) or cooking meals during your stay. Cabin Cruises: The Budget-Friendly Entry Point to Sailing A Cabin Cruise is a smart choice for those who want to experience the yachting lifestyle without renting an entire boat. You can book an individual, private cabin with its own bathroom on a large, modern catamaran. The journey follows a pre-planned route, and meals are prepared and served by the crew. Think of it as staying at a boutique hotel that drops anchor at a different, beautiful spot every day. Why the BVI Is Ideal for First-Time Yacht Vacations The British Virgin Islands are widely considered the sailing capital of the Caribbean. The unique geography of the region creates a gentle, welcoming environment for anyone new to the water. Line-of-Sight Navigation and Calm Waters One of the biggest comfort factors in the BVI is that you can almost always see the next island on the horizon. item.title: Top Honeymoon Yacht Charter Vacation Packages
item.description: Honeymooners planning their celebrational trip are looking for the ultimate romantic experience, filled with wonderful meals, adventure and luxury. Does that sound like something you’re after? Look no further! With 15+ package destinations to discover, choose from some of the best destinations for a honeymoon. Enjoy an Indian Ocean exotic paradise, French Polynesia lagoons, the hongs of Thailand or Caribbean sunsets – whichever destination you’d prefer, rest assured we’ve got it covered. You can rent a cabin on our by the cabin yacht charters in some of the world’s most beautiful destinations, or rent a luxury yacht with crew for a five-star, once-in-a-lifetime honeymoon sailing trip. Here are some memorable experiences to get you started… 1. Sail Tahiti for adventurous honeymooners Spend your honeymoon yacht charter diving, snorkeling, surfing and fishing in Tahiti’s crystal lagoons. Its lush rainforest and volcanic landscape are a majestic and dramatic backdrop to your honeymoon. Sail the wonders of Bora Bora, Raiatea, Huahine, Morea and Rangiroa. See amazing marine life while on the water, including sharks and rays. Or head inland to explore trails and inlets. Discover Tahiti’s ancient history, archaeological sites and hear traditional Tahitian wooden drums known as ‘pahu’ as you enjoy a cocktail. We offer four to 11-day by the cabin charters in French Polynesia , as well as private crewed yachts . Read a customer review of our crewed yacht charter in Raiatea . 2. Thailand island hopping for exotic delights Thailand is a destination that is best explored by yacht. A southeast Asia honeymoon includes limestone peaks, fairytale cliffs and ancient temples. Hop between Thailand’s 300 islands, perfect for secluded coves, dramatic photography and sultry sunsets. Explore the granite and jungle-rich Similan Islands, Koh Phi Phi’s jagged cliff formations or swim in underwater seascapes. Stargazing at Phang Nga Bay is a must! There’s a reason why Thailand is one of the top honeymoon destinations. Discover why by choosing from our 8-day Thailand by the cabin charters or Thailand crewed fleet. 3. Martinique sailing honeymoons for history buffs Martinique’s brilliant white-sand beaches and spectacular historic and cultural sites mean it’s perfect for couples in search of history and French culture during their honeymoon sailing trip. Explore tropical gardens, an active volcano or enjoy historical attractions, such as Fort Royal (Fort Saint Louis), the Palais de Justice, and the Cathédrale Saint-Louis with its distinctive 58m-high spire. Fort-de-France, Martinique’s capital, invites visitors to learn about the island’s pre-Columbian and colonial past. With fascinating on-shore activities, Martinique is the ideal destination for couples looking for experiences on-shore as well as on the water. Find out more about Martinique , book an 8-day or 11-day Martinique by the cabin charter , or find a crewed yacht in Martinique. 4. Glamorous honeymoon escapes to the Cote d’Azur If you’re seeking a honeymoon with glamor, the Côte d’Azur is the international place to be for jet setters. Iconic landscapes will greet you as you anchor in one of the many sophisticated cities ripe for exploring. Whether you want to browse local markets for fresh lavender and handmade soaps, get lost in the winding alleyways of old towns, or catch a glimpse of a celebrity, sailing the Côte d’Azur will leave you with unlimited options. The Côte d’Azur follows the coastline from Toulon to Monaco. While hotspots like St. Tropez are exciting, inland spots hold peaceful pleasures. Join locals and head for the hills for a hike, waterfall swim and rosé sipping. In Nice, hike up Castle Hill, pack a picnic and enjoy the splendid view. Visit Monaco, the home of yachts and royalty, or take the train to the famous Michelin-starred restaurant, Chevre D’or in Èze.
